name: ck12_12_save
description: Test 12. Write (shipped values, noon) gives the 26-byte example of 7: 02 00 | 0 | 135.0 | 2000.0 | 43200 | 20 | 1. A version-1 record of 36 bytes (the 10-byte timer record 02 | 0 x 8 | 00 after seconds) reads completely, skips the timer record and leaves the timer, the visual time and the minimum alone; rewriting gives version 2 (26 bytes) with the same values. A version-3 record reads as version 2. A record cut inside nightStart fails; the fields before it are stored. The 421 corpus records are not in the repository (see the coverage notes).
